newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks start lower, Popular continues climb.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks start lower, Popular continues climb.

text.p: MADRID, June 27 (Reuter) 0900 GMT - Madrid stocks were lower in early trade on Friday, consolidating recent highs in mixed trade, dealers said.

* Banco Popular up 2.30 percent to 36,000 pesetas, favoured by recent data showing a climb in consumption and with some investors switching out of other banks, dealers said. Trade also boosted by a put through order. Popular's annual shareholders' meeting takes place today.
* Telefonica down 0.91 percent to 4,335 pesetas after stock market watchdog CNMV said it was to issue 100.0 billion pesetas of convertible dollar bonds, aimed at foreign investors.
* General index down 0.49 points, 0.08 percent, to 603.20
